title: This Crab Wears a Living Costume With No Glue
subject: decorator crab

scenes.text: This crab wears a living costume. And there is no glue holding it on.
It's a decorator crab. It picks up seaweed, sponges, even live sea anemones.
Its shell is covered in curled, hooked hairs. Pieces of seaweed simply catch on them.
A kelp crab works a piece of seaweed back and forth until it wedges in, then tugs to test the hold.
The seaweed hides its fluttering antennae from birds, and anemones sting anything that attacks.
No glue. Just hooks. That is all it takes to vanish.
